svg.title: AMB3R-Conditioned Trajectory-Guided Heatmap Head
svg.desc: Publication figure showing a frozen causal AMB3R pose stream and a frozen Qwen visual stream feeding a trajectory-guided four-direction heatmap head. Ground-truth geometry appears only in a dashed training-label path. Raw heatmap and visibility logits feed a tokenizer and zero-gated System-1 adapters.
svg.text: Causal monocular poses replace simulator pose inputs; frozen visual features support structured four-direction localization.
sample the same K history IDs
pᵢ = [forward, left, cos Δyaw, sin Δyaw]
VO pose input for adaptation and inference
one frozen forward over independent images
restored ViT rasters · spatially fused in Head
No Right / Back / Left RGB enters the Head.
observed Front + learned R/B/L slots with pooled Front context
fine-detail skip from conditioned current features
Pretrain the full Head with GT-pose inputs → adapt only pose-sensitive fusion/readouts to causal AMB3R poses → freeze the Head for navigation.
Two consumers — no hidden RGB shortcut.
spatial softmax × five-way [none, F, R, B, L] confidence
raw logits + visibility + history age / mask
history-major, then F / R / B / L tokens
GT is a teacher, not a sensor.
no GT pose · no depth · no intrinsics

dashed path supervises raw heatmap + visibility predictions only
All RGB inputs to this branch are Front view; F / R / B / L denotes the fixed output direction order.
